title: Learning Forced Multibody Dynamics on Lie Groups
abstract: arXiv:2607.12627v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce an architecture for learning the dynamics of forced mechanical systems evolving on Lie groups, based on discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations. The proposed method, termed Lie Group Discrete Forced Euler-Lagrange Neural Network (LieDFLNN), learns mechanical dynamics directly from discrete configuration observations, without requiring velocity measurements. This formulation allows the simultaneous identification of unknown mechanical properties and forcing terms, while ensuring that the predicted configurations remain on the underlying Lie group. We develop explicit formulations for rigid body dynamics on $SO(3)$ and $SE(3)$, extend the framework to interacting multibody systems, and introduce a method for learning unknown control forces when the Lagrangian is known. Finally, we evaluate the method through numerical experiments involving rigid body dynamics, nonlinear external forces, controlled systems, and real-world

translated_title: 李群上受迫多体动力学的学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于学习演化于李群上的受迫机械系统动力学的架构，该架构基于离散受迫欧拉-拉格朗日方程。所提出的方法被称为李群离散受迫欧拉-拉格朗日神经网络，能够直接从离散的位形观测数据中学习机械动力学，而无需速度测量。该公式化方法可以同时识别未知的机械属性和外力项，同时确保预测的位形始终保持在底层李群上。我们针对 $SO(3)$ 和 $SE(3)$ 上的刚体动力学建立了显式公式，将该框架扩展到相互耦合的多体系统，并提出了一种在拉格朗日量已知的情况下学习未知控制力的方法。最后，我们通过涉及刚体动力学、非线性外力、受控系统以及真实世界数据的数值实验对该方法进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于离散受迫欧拉-拉格朗日方程的LieDFLNN神经网络，仅凭位形观测数据（无需速度测量）即可学习李群上的受迫多体动力学，并能同时辨识未知的机械属性与外力项。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LieDFLNN, a discrete forced Euler-Lagrange neural network that learns forced multibody dynamics on Lie groups directly from configuration observations without velocity measurements, while simultaneously identifying unknown mechanical properties and forcing terms.
